quote: Sandvik has received a major order for underground mining equipment from the Canadian mining company Aris Mining, to be used at the Marmato gold mine in Colombia. The order is valued at around SEK 250 million and was booked in the first quarter of 2026.
note: Opened Sandvik English; ~SEK 250m / Marmato / Aris Mining confirmed. CapEx-fill USD via Fed H.10 Sep 25 2026 9.9047 SEK/USD.
